column2: So much green. It really feels like the great outdoors...
Shh! I hear something! Like a beast growling... It's getting louder!
Grrrr... Grrrrrr...!
Shouldn't we run?
You finally showed uuup!
GRAAAAH! Huh...?
Eek!
Whoa!
Um, was that growling you?
Heh heh, you heard that? I'm Animaru Kedaman! I thought you were Dorano, so I jumped ya... Sorry!
Is your house somewhere in this jungle?
We're already INSIDE my house!
It's like you're living in the wild!
Not LIKE, I AM! Living the wild life for real! So who are you guys?
I'm {p}. And they're my friends!
Wow, you've got lots of friends. Lucky!
By the way, who's Dorano?
A survivor of the Dracula clan!
...!? You mean a vampire?
The Dracula clan's known as bloodsuckers, but... that's wrong!\n\nThe truth is... they don't suck blood. They suck boobs and chomp on butts. They're not bloodsuckers, they're BUTT-suckers...
Eww!
That Dorano's got a big rivalry thing going with me, see. He sent me a challenge! A duel, he says. Heh heh heh...!
So this Dorano's coming here?
Yep! But maybe he... went to the wrong gate? Eh, whatever! If you see Dorano anywhere, tell him I'm waiting! Later!
...What an odd kid.
Dorano...? What a weird name.
Dorano...?\n\nIsn't Dorano the guy Kedaman's dueling?
Um...
Gyah!?\n\nWhoa, you scared me... Don't just barge into people's homes!
Sorry...\n\nBut why do you live under a grave?
Live secretly underground and sell the land up top as burial plots! That's the Dracula clan's money-making secret!
The Dracula clan... Then you're Dorano-kun?
You know me?
Kedaman is waiting for you!
Aaah! Oh no!!\n\nI'm late for my duel with Kedaman! I'm coming, Kedaman!!
I'm late for my duel with Kedaman! I'm coming, Kedaman!!
Yo! You guys!
Kedaman!
I had a hunch, so I came by. Sure enough, this guy overslept...! Pfffft...!
Shut up! Prepare yourself, Kedaman! Today, I swear on the Dracula clan's honor, I'll beat you!
Hey, Dorano, that's dirty!
If it's a duel, it's one on one, Dorano-kun!
Bystanders butt out! Here I come, Kedaman!
Kedaman, we've got your back!
Yeah, thanks!
Man, you guys are strong!
Heh heh, not really.
By the way, the town looks kinda different... Did something happen?
Didn't an earthquake happen in your town?
Actually...
Whaaat!? All that happened!?
We still don't know exactly what's going on, though...
Sounds like a blast! I'm coming with you!
Gyah!
You're coming too!\n\nMy wild blood's boiling! Raaaaaah!!
Hey, Dorano!
I am Grade...\n\nHave you forgotten me, "Sun of rebirth"...?
You who form a "pair" with the "Moon of destruction," hear me... The world is being reborn...

When the time of joining at last arrives...\n\nI shall draw you to me, and make all things one... A world freed from every pain, hatred and sorrow... Come with me, and I shall free you from everything...
...All kinds of memories are getting jumbled up... My head hurts...
Are you okay?
So you came here after all...
You were meant to come here. You know that, don't you?
Guard-san... I see, so it's true...!
I've got a bad feeling... We shouldn't go any further...
What are you talking about, {p}! The fighting's too heavy on the other roads. We'll never get through!
I know you're uneasy, but there's nothing for it. Be brave!
Y-yeah...
Us being made the "Moon of destruction" and the "Sun of rebirth" was pure, total chance, you see! At first, anyway.
At first... What do you mean?
You really don't remember anything... You refused the Demon King's offer once. And you remade the world with your own power!
That's ridiculous!
The eclipse is almost here. Then you'll remember.
Why won't you say anything?
You really don't remember anything. Can't blame you, though. I only remembered recently myself.
What have you been going on about!?
Your memories are just like the world: a total patchwork!
My memories too...
Do you know why the Demon King locked you in the Dimension Prison? Because he wants you to remember!
Remember...?
You've seen a tragedy like the one in the Dimension Prison once before, haven't you?
Miki-chan, attacked by the rioters...!
So you remember. The sad thing that happened to Akira-kun...
Ugh... My head's starting to hurt...
Your head hurts? I see... You must not want to remember. For you, so sure you have to stop the Demon King, it's hard to understand...
So how can we stop that tragedy?
If we step into the light the black sun shines, the two of us can go back to our own world. Then everything that happened because of the Dimension Chain will go back to how it was...
But if we try hard, we can manage somehow!
Hahahahaha...!!
What's so funny!?
When worlds are joined, the time in each world gets ignored, you know.\n\nThe flow of time has nothing to do with the Dimension Chain.
So what!
It means the Demon King can redo things as many times as he likes. Just like a game: if he doesn't like it, reset!
That doesn't mean we just let the Demon King do whatever he wants!
You don't like it? But {p}... it's over...! Look at that!!
It's true. You saw it too, didn't you? You lived it, didn't you?\n\nThe Demon King is trying to remake a world wrapped in sorrow! Into a world where nobody suffers, with no hatred or anger!
What the Demon King is doing is just like a revolution! He's trying to change the world for people suffering under a dictator!
{s}! The Demon King is wrong!! And so are you! The Demon King is deceiving you!
